name: @specship/specship-ui
description: SpecShip Desktop — the dashboard SPA (REQ-DESKTOP-017). Standalone module: own lockfile, runtime deps exactly react + react-dom, builds to static assets in dist/ that the dashboard server serves same-origin. All charts/icons/graph render from in-module SVG components; fonts are self-hosted (no CDN).

scripts.build: node ../scripts/check-ui-deps.mjs && tsc && vite build && node ../scripts/check-ui-deps.mjs --dist dist
